title: Đề luyện Viết VSTEP — Recall SGU0822

questions.content:
writing — Task 1

You have received an email from your friend Lee, who says she is coming to visit your city on the 11th. Write back to Lee. In your email you should: 1. Say whether you can pick her up and tell her about the plans you have arranged. 2. Tell her about the weather and what clothes to bring (she is worried about the weather and asked whether she can bring light, short clothes). 3. Recommend the most interesting or beautiful place to visit in your city.

writing — Task 2

Some people think that the government should spend money on training people to do practical jobs, such as repairing cars and building houses, instead of investing in university education. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
